title: Inertia (জড়তা)
placement: Book pages 64–65, topic 3.1.1: জড়তা (Inertia). Next to the paragraphs about a car starting suddenly and getting off a moving bus or train.
description: Interactive 3D figure for inertia (জড়তা), book pages 64–65, topic 3.1.1. A Dhaka city bus, with its left side cut away (a plank floor, powder-blue lining), on a street of shops under a blue sky, with a school student standing inside, holding nothing. The student chooses an event and watches it in slow motion (time 3x slower, said in the panel): the bus starts suddenly (2.5 m/s² for 1 s): the feet go with the bus, the upper body stays where it was (a dashed mark shows where his head was), he leans back (স্থিতি জড়তা); the bus brakes suddenly from 4.5 m/s (3 m/s²): the feet stop with the bus, the upper body runs on, he leans forward (গতি জড়তা); he steps off the bus moving at 3 m/s: in the air he keeps the bus's speed, on the road his feet stop and the upper body runs on, he tumbles forward onto his hands and knees (গতি জড়তা). A fourth event is the coin-and-card trick on a glass on a wooden table (time 10x slower): the flicked card shoots away, the coin stays and drops into the glass (স্থিতি জড়তা). A bold, white-rimmed blue arrow on the feet (or the card) and an orange one at the shoulders (or on the coin) show each part's speed along the road; the panel gives both speeds in m/s and the book's explanation; labels say what each part does while it is true. Start and brake end once he stands upright again. Physics: the standing body is an inverted pendulum about the ankles (I = 1.3 m L², L = 0.92 m) with muscle stiffness and damping (ratio 0.68), driven by the bus's acceleration; stepping off, the upper body runs on at the bus's speed as the feet stop; the coin feels friction (μ = 0.25) only while the card slides under it (a few hundredths of a second). The camera moves on at the speed everything had before the push, so the upper body is seen to stay while the feet are carried away. Test tab: 5 questions (why one leans back, which way one leans on starting or braking, inertia of rest or motion with its reason, which way one falls stepping off, the coin, a gentle start); after each answer the scene plays on and shows it. Phone-first, Bangla.
